levels.name: Tier I — Card Table & Optimism
levels.blurb: A folding table, a desk lamp, and a signed waiver you wrote yourself.

levels.name: Tier II — The Rumbler Rig
levels.blurb: A gantry, a winch, and a second organ bay. Unlocks TWO chassis at once — the L-class Rumbler and the A-class Kite — and lets you install two organs. The Rumbler carries anything and flies never; the Kite is a flying wing with no back legs, light enough to get airborne on plain standard-grade parts. Ground-level attacks swing straight under anything actually in the air.
levels.unlockLine: Surgery Theater upgraded to Tier II. The gantry arrived on a flatbed, the wind tunnel arrived in seven boxes, and the neighbours have stopped asking.
levels.news: Farm supply store reports a run on industrial winches. "Big year for barns," says owner, unconvincingly.

levels.name: Holding Bay & A Very Firm Door
levels.blurb: One reinforced pen, one padlock, one folding chair for staring contests. Anything you impound can be dismantled for its parts — and that is the only thing it can be.

levels.name: Tier II — The Reorientation Wing
levels.blurb: Soft lighting, enrichment toys, and a motivational poster of you. Lets you REHABILITATE a captured chimera into your own roster instead of taking it apart — someone else's anatomy, someone else's grades, on your team.
levels.unlockLine: Reorientation Wing open for business. The first intake has already chewed the motivational poster.
levels.news: County shelter reports unusual new competitor: "They keep taking the scary ones," says volunteer, relieved.

levels.name: Tier III — The Enrichment Annexe
levels.blurb: A ball pit, a climbing wall, and a full-time behaviourist who has stopped asking where the specimens come from. Reorientation runs in half the time for two thirds the money.
levels.unlockLine: Enrichment Annexe complete. The ball pit was expensive and is, regrettably, load-bearing.
levels.news: Sporting goods wholesaler baffled by single order of 40,000 plastic balls. Delivery driver declines to comment.

levels.name: Tier IV — The Reconciliation Wing
levels.blurb: A full behavioural annexe with its own catering. Programmes run in a third of the time at a fraction of the fee, and specimens leave asking after your health.
levels.unlockLine: Containment upgraded to Tier IV. The Reconciliation Wing has a water feature. The specimens voted on it.
levels.news: County planning office approves "livestock wellness annexe." Blueprints show a lecture theatre.

levels.name: Three Drawers And A Lamp
levels.blurb: Three warm drawers, one desk lamp, and a hand-lettered sign reading DO NOT OPEN.

levels.name: Tier II — The Egg Wall
levels.blurb: Five bays on a thermostat that actually works. Eggs come out a fifth sooner and, because a stable temperature is where odd things happen, they mutate a third more often.
levels.unlockLine: Egg Wall installed. Five bays, one thermostat, and a hum you will get used to.
levels.news: Hardware store sells out of thermostats. "Someone is building something," says clerk, correctly.

levels.name: Tier III — Hatchery Row
levels.blurb: Eight bays, individually climate-controlled, humming in harmony. Incubation runs at half time, very nearly twice as many eggs come out carrying something nobody put there, and half of those surprises are a variant line rather than a loose gene — which is the only place an Alpine Ram has ever come from.
levels.unlockLine: Hatchery Row online. It sings at 3am. Nobody has decided whether that is a problem.
levels.news: Neighbours report "a low chord, at night, from the old Cook place." Sleep quality otherwise unaffected.

levels.name: Tier V — The Hatchery Floor
levels.blurb: Twelve bays, climate-matched to the parent stock, and a gene-splicing draught that makes surprises the rule rather than the exception — two in every three of them a variant of the line you bred.
levels.unlockLine: Incubator upgraded to Tier V. Twelve bays, and a noise from the far end that nobody has claimed.
levels.news: Agricultural supplier reports a single order for twelve industrial incubators. "Big year for eggs."

levels.name: Hand-Cranked & Hopeful
levels.blurb: A centrifuge you turn yourself. Grade is whatever the animal brought to the table.

levels.name: Tier II — Servo-Assisted Draw
levels.blurb: A motor, a cold trap, and a draw that stops bruising the sample. Every extraction grades a little better than the animal strictly earned.
levels.unlockLine: Servo-Assisted Draw fitted. You will never crank anything again and you are at peace with that.
levels.news: Dairy equipment supplier reports "an unusual customer with very specific centrifuge needs."

levels.name: Tier III — Cryogenic Column
levels.blurb: Liquid nitrogen, a column the height of the barn, and a grade forecast that flatters everybody.
levels.unlockLine: Cryogenic Column commissioned. The barn is now the second-coldest place in the county.
levels.news: Industrial gas depot notes record nitrogen order. "Ice cream," said the customer. It was not ice cream.

levels.name: Tier IV — The Graduation Suite
levels.blurb: Every donor leaves at close to its theoretical best. The ceremony now includes a gown.
levels.unlockLine: Extractor upgraded to Tier IV. There is a gown. There is, regrettably, a small orchestra.
levels.news: Local tailor reports commission for "forty graduation gowns, various shapes." Declines to elaborate.

levels.name: Squinting At It Thoughtfully
levels.blurb: You can tell a lot from an animal by looking at it. You can tell nothing at all about its alleles.

levels.name: Tier II — Bench Sequencer
levels.blurb: Reads what an animal CARRIES, not just what it shows. Every recessive in the pens becomes visible — which is the difference between breeding and hoping.
levels.unlockLine: Bench Sequencer calibrated. Half the herd is carrying something and you finally know which half.
levels.news: Regional lab reports theft of one sequencer. Thief left exact payment in cash and a thank-you note.

levels.name: Tier III — Predictive Pairing Suite
levels.blurb: Runs the Punnett square for you: pick two parents and it tells you, to the percent, what the egg can carry and what it will actually express. Breeding stops being a prayer.
levels.unlockLine: Pairing Suite online. It has opinions about your breeding programme and they are unkind.
levels.news: Statistics department reports missing workstation. "It was doing something with goats," says nobody.

levels.name: A Bucket And A Kind Word
levels.blurb: One cot, one bucket, and a great deal of encouragement. Convalescence takes as long as it takes.

levels.name: Tier II — Veterinary Bay
levels.blurb: Proper lighting, proper splints, proper drugs. Injuries clear in two thirds the time and treatment costs less.
levels.unlockLine: Veterinary Bay open. There is a chart on the wall and somebody is updating it.
levels.news: Veterinary wholesaler notes a new bulk account. Species field left blank. Twice.

levels.name: Tier III — Regenerative Suite
levels.blurb: Tanks, tubes, and a tissue printer. Injuries clear in under half the time, treatment is cheap, and an untreated one sets badly far less often.
levels.unlockLine: Regenerative Suite commissioned. Something in tank three is watching you back.
levels.news: Medical supply firm reports its largest ever order of "unspecified growth medium." Delivery went to a barn.

levels.name: Tier IV — The Recovery Wing
levels.blurb: Injuries close in a third of the time, cost a third to treat, and almost never set badly.
levels.unlockLine: Infirmary upgraded to Tier IV. The Recovery Wing has a physiotherapy pool and a strict no-biting policy.
levels.news: Regional hospital reports theft of one (1) hydrotherapy pool. Tyre tracks described as "enormous."

stalls.comment: R154 — a pen is a pen. Every `pensPerStall` pens past the paddock you start with houses a chimera as well as stock, so 'Expand the pens' finally does what it says. Twelve is what the rest of the game can carry today: at 9 and 6 the stable grows past what the walker tends (a fixed three a day, R138) and R138's own level gate goes red with 7-8 creatures stuck at zero, while at 6 and below R85's no-neglect promise breaks too. At 12 both improve — L0 goes 2 to 0. Raising it further needs the tending to scale, filed as R155. `freePens` restates ranch TUNING.penStartCapacity and smoke asserts the two match, so the restatement cannot drift.
